_readme: Source of truth for German terms. i18n-kit.config.ts reads it. Edit the German here; run `pnpm i18n:translate` for new keys, add --overwriteStale or delete a key in de.json to redo one. 'preserve' terms are never translated.

Library.note: the tab and 'your Library'; 'in your Library' = 'in deiner Bibliothek'

Want to read.note: Goodreads' German shelf name; status and list; in a sentence: 'zu „Möchte ich lesen“ hinzugefügt'

Currently reading.note: Goodreads' German shelf name; status and Home row

Reading.note: ONLY as the short segment/filter label next to Want to read and Finished

Finished.note: Goodreads' German shelf name 'Gelesen'; the status label. The verb 'finish' is 'beenden', 'finished a book' = 'hat ein Buch zu Ende gelesen'

DNF.note: did not finish; 'Did not finish' / 'Abandoned' = 'Abgebrochen'; 'didn't finish' (verb) = 'abgebrochen'

Read as.note: how a member read an entry: physical, ebook or audiobook

Shelf.note: Goodreads' German 'Regal' (plural 'Regale', 'Bücherregal'); 'Your shelf' = 'Dein Regal' (the owner's shelf feature is called Regal)

Friends.note: the people you follow and what they read, as Goodreads' German 'Freunde'; 'Your friends' = 'Deine Freunde' (Home, the feed, Profile); generic plural, no gender sign. The word 'circle' no longer appears in the English

Member.note: plural 'Mitglieder'; neutral, use instead of any gendered word

Rating.note: as Goodreads; 'Rated {rating} out of 5' = 'Mit {rating} von 5 bewertet'; stars = 'Sterne'

Review.note: as Goodreads; the member's written review; verb 'rezensieren' / 'hat eine Rezension geschrieben'

Author.note: plural 'Autoren'; generic form, no gender sign. OWNER TO CONFIRM (alternative: Autor:in / Autor:innen)

Placeholder cover.note: the generated cover with title and author on a coloured surface

A read (noun).note: one reading of a book; 'First read' = 'Erste Lektüre'; counts: '{count} read | {count} reads' = '{count} Lektüre | {count} Lektüren'

Glass.note: the translucent-chrome setting; levels Strong / Medium / Off = Stark / Mittel / Aus
